subject: Kickoff: SelfCLR-LLP - bag-level learning for privacy-constrained customers
body:
Team,

Kicking off the LLP representations track. The customer problem: ad and recommendation partners increasingly get only bag-level label proportions, not instance labels, and they still need competitive models. Our open-source SelfCLR-LLP release (the CIKM'22 domain-agnostic contrastive method) is the strongest thing we have here, and the repo already benchmarks it against DLLP and fully-supervised baselines on Criteo-Kaggle and MovieLens-1M with the standard 75:20:5 train/test/val split.

Milestones: repro both benchmark tables by May 29; a large-scale contrastive pretraining sweep in late June to test how the method scales; customer-facing eval memo by July 17.

Alina - staffing and the compute reservation are the long poles, especially the June sweep. Can you confirm both by end of next week?

Dmitri
